# iPayX FX Proof API

Audit FX transactions against the mid-market rate. Returns the hidden spread, true cost, and an FX score (1–10).

Base URL

`https://api.ipayx.ai/v1`

Authentication

`Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_…`

POST

`/audit`

Submit up to 50 FX transactions per request. The API fetches the mid-market rate at the time of each transaction, computes the spread and implicit cost, and returns an FX execution score for the batch.

### Headers

`Content-Type`

string

required

Must be `application/json`.

`Authorization`

string

required

`Bearer ipx_live_…` — generate keys from /developers while signed in.

### Request body

JSON Copy

```
{
  "language": "en",
  "transactions": [
    {
      "id": "tx_001",
      "source_currency": "CAD",
      "target_currency": "USD",
      "source_amount": 10000,
      "target_amount": 7250,
      "date": "2026-04-18T15:32:00Z",
      "provider_name": "BigBank_CA"
    }
  ]
}
```

`transactions`

array

required

Up to 50 transaction objects. Each object must include all fields below.

`transactions[].id`

string

required

Your internal transaction identifier. Echoed back in the response.

`transactions[].source_currency`

string

required

3-letter ISO code (e.g. `"CAD"`).

`transactions[].target_currency`

string

required

3-letter ISO code (e.g. `"USD"`).

`transactions[].source_amount`

number

required

Amount debited in `source_currency`.

`transactions[].target_amount`

number

required

Amount received in `target_currency`.

`transactions[].date`

ISO 8601

Execution timestamp. Optional.

`transactions[].provider_name`

string

Free-text label for the provider/bank. Optional.

`language`

string

`"en"` (default) or `"fr"`. Controls the AI commentary language.

### Response — 200 OK

JSON Copy

```
{
  "fx_score": 6,
  "score_rating": "fair",
  "avg_spread_pct": 1.823,
  "total_fx_cost": 132.02,
  "transactions_analyzed": 1,
  "transactions": [
    {
      "id": "tx_001",
      "source_currency": "CAD",
      "target_currency": "USD",
      "source_amount": 10000,
      "target_amount": 7250,
      "mid_rate": 0.738523,
      "client_rate": 0.725,
      "spread_pct": 1.823,
      "fx_cost": -132.02,
      "commentary": "A 1.823% spread on a CAD/USD transaction is meaningfully above the typical mid-market reference. The implicit cost of ~132 CAD on a 10,000 notional reflects a non-competitive execution. Consider routing larger volumes through specialised FX providers."
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "plan": "starter",
    "audits_this_month": 1,
    "soft_limit": 1000,
    "over_limit": false
  }
}
```

`fx_score`

number

Execution score from 1 (critical) to 10 (excellent).

`score_rating`

string

`excellent | good | fair | poor | critical`.

`avg_spread_pct`

number

Average spread across all submitted transactions, in percent.

`total_fx_cost`

number

Sum of absolute implicit costs across the batch, in source currency units.

`transactions`

array

Per-transaction results: `mid_rate`, `client_rate`, `spread_pct`, `fx_cost`, and an AI `commentary` on the first item.

`usage`

object

Current month usage: `plan`, `audits_this_month`, `soft_limit`, `over_limit`.

### Error — 401 Unauthorized

JSON Copy

```
{
  "error": "invalid_api_key",
  "message": "Missing or malformed Authorization header"
}
```

### Error — 400 Validation

JSON Copy

```
{
  "error": "validation_error",
  "message": "Transaction tx_001 missing required fields (id, source_currency, target_currency, source_amount, target_amount)"
}
```

### Error — 429 Rate Limit

JSON Copy

```
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "message": "Too many requests. Try again later."
}
```

Rate limits are enforced per API key on a rolling 60-second window. The limit depends on your plan.

### cURL

bash Copy

```
curl -X POST https://api.ipayx.ai/v1/audit \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
  "language": "en",
  "transactions": [
    {
      "id": "tx_001",
      "source_currency": "CAD",
      "target_currency": "USD",
      "source_amount": 10000,
      "target_amount": 7250,
      "date": "2026-04-18T15:32:00Z",
      "provider_name": "BigBank_CA"
    }
  ]
}'
```

Notes

- Generate API keys from the /developers page once signed in. Keys start with `ipx_live_`.
- Maximum 50 transactions per request. Submit additional batches if needed.
- Mid-market rates are fetched live from regulated interbank data providers.
- Soft monthly limits apply per plan: Starter 1,000 / Pro 10,000 / Enterprise unmetered. Above the soft limit, an `X-Usage-Warning` header is returned.
